# Pull Request

## Description
Brief description of changes and their purpose.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Historical accuracy enhancement

## Historical Context
For Bell System-related changes:
- [ ] Changes maintain historical accuracy (1978-1983 period)
- [ ] Terminology verified against Bell System documentation
- [ ] Command syntax follows authentic UNIX V7 patterns
- [ ] Operational procedures match Bell System practices

## Testing
- [ ] I have tested these changes locally
- [ ] I have run the test suite (`bell-system --test`)
- [ ] I have tested with multiple user roles
- [ ] I have verified CLI functionality
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality

## Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 style guidelines
- [ ] Code has been formatted with black
- [ ] Code passes flake8 linting
- [ ] Type hints added where appropriate
- [ ] Docstrings added for public functions

## Documentation
- [ ] README.md updated if needed
- [ ] API documentation updated if needed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated following Keep a Changelog format
- [ ] Examples added for new features

## Checklist
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Code commented where necessary
- [ ] No new warnings introduced
- [ ] All CI checks passing
